Dosage form(s): This monograph excludes foods or food-like dosage forms as indicated in the Compendium of Monographs Guidance Document.
Acceptable dosage forms for oral use are indicated in the dosage form drop-down list of the web-based Product Licence Application form for Compendial applications.

Use(s) or Purpose(s): Source of antioxidants/Provides antioxidants (Heber et al. 2007; Rosenblat et al. 2006; Aviram et al. 2004; Aviram et al. 2000).
Source of antioxidants/Provides antioxidants that help fight/protect (cell) against/reduce (the oxidative effect of/the oxidative damage caused by/cell damage caused by) free radicals (Heber et al. 2007; Rosenblat et al. 2006; Aviram et al. 2004; Aviram et al. 2000).

Quantity(ies): Methods of preparation: Dry, Powdered, Non-Standardized Extracts (Dry extract, Tincture, Fluid extract, Decoction, Decoction concentrate, Infusion, Infusion concentrate)
Not to exceed 20 grams of dried fruit/seed aril, per day (CNF 2024).
Not to exceed 100 grams of fresh fruit/seed aril, per day (CNF 2024).
